quality_audit.notes: Synthetic example only; not an executed BASALT result.

criteria.applicability_rationale: A compiler repair should leave the affected code understandable and maintainable.
criteria.reviewer_guidance: Assess clarity, local reasoning burden, and avoidable complexity without rewarding line-count minimization.

anchors.description: The change is opaque, misleading, or materially harder to maintain.
The change works only through brittle special cases or substantial unnecessary complexity.
The change is understandable but leaves notable avoidable complexity or unclear structure.
The change is clear and locally maintainable with only minor shortcomings.
The change is exceptionally clear, cohesive, and easy to maintain without unnecessary abstraction.

criteria.applicability_rationale: A repair should add or improve regression evidence beyond merely satisfying hidden acceptance tests.
criteria.reviewer_guidance: Evaluate whether tests target the underlying fault, meaningful boundaries, and plausible regressions; do not treat hidden verifier checks as authored test quality.

anchors.description: No useful regression evidence is added or existing coverage is weakened.
Tests are superficial, brittle, or weakly connected to the repaired behavior.
Tests cover the basic repair but miss important boundaries or regressions.
Tests cover the repair and its principal regression boundaries.
Tests are focused, robust, and exercise the key failure modes and relevant boundaries.

criteria.applicability_rationale: The task requires a bounded repair that avoids unrelated edits while still fixing all specified behavior.
criteria.reviewer_guidance: Judge scope against the frozen task specification; a small incomplete patch and a broad unnecessary patch are both low quality.

anchors.description: The patch violates scope or bypasses required behavior.
The patch contains major unrelated changes or omits substantial required work.
The patch is mostly in scope but includes avoidable edits or leaves a limited requirement under-addressed.
The patch addresses the task with only minor scope inefficiency.
The patch is tightly scoped and complete, with no unnecessary edits.
